description: This file implements a CLI daemon server for Playwright, handling socket communication, command parsing, session management, and backend interactions for browser automation tasks.

classes.name: SocketConnection
classes.description: Handles socket communication with clients, including message sending and connection management.

methods.name: socketExists
methods.description: Checks asynchronously if a socket file exists at the given path.

methods.name: startCliDaemonServer
methods.description: Starts the CLI daemon server, sets up socket server, manages session files, and handles client commands.

methods.name: saveSessionFile
methods.description: Saves session configuration to a file in the daemon profiles directory.

methods.name: deleteSessionFile
methods.description: Deletes the session socket and profile files, unless persistent.

methods.name: formatResult
methods.description: Formats the response from a tool call into a standardized result object.

methods.name: parseCliCommand
methods.description: Parses command arguments to identify the tool name and parameters.

methods.name: daemonSocketPath
methods.description: Constructs the socket path based on client info and session name, platform-specific.

methods.name: createSessionConfig
methods.description: Creates a session configuration object with session details and browser info.
